items.title: Eurosystem brings central bank money to tokenised finance
items.summary: The European Central Bank has launched Pontes, a solution that enables wholesale transactions in tokenised assets to be settled in central bank money.
items.why: ECB launches official infrastructure enabling central bank money settlement for tokenised wholesale assets.

items.title: ClearToken wins Bank of England approval to clear tokenised assets
items.summary: ClearToken, a a London-based clearing house for global digital assets, has been approved by the Bank of England to operate a Digital Securities Depository (DSD) in the Digital Securities Sandbox.
items.why: Bank of England approval marks key milestone in UK digital securities and clearing infrastructure.

items.title: Russian fintech A7 exploited Swift controls to funnel billion of dollars in sanctioned payments
items.summary: An FT investigation has uncoverd a massive money laundering scam conducted by Kremlin-controlled fintech A7 that tricked international banks into handling billions of dollars in sanction-busting payments to Russian state companies.
items.why: Major investigation reveals multi-billion-dollar sanctions evasion exploiting Swift and international banking controls.

items.title: Russian fintech A7 exploited bank controls to funnel billion of dollars in sanctioned payments
items.summary: An FT investigation has uncoverd a massive money laundering scam conducted by Kremlin-controlled fintech A7 that tricked international banks into handling billions of dollars in sanction-busting payments to Russian state companies.
items.why: Major investigative revelation of massive sanctions evasion via exploited bank controls.

items.title: Community 'blindsided' by legislation change fears becoming ghost town
items.summary: The state government introduces legislation to repeal a requirement for a coal mine to house its workforce in a nearby town.
items.why: Government introduced legislation repealing a coal mine's local workforce housing requirement.

items.title: US Fed hikes interest rates to curb inflation in move likely to rile Trump
items.summary: The US economy has been dealing with years of higher-than-target inflation, and prices have surged in the wake of Mr Trump's war on Iran, his signature tariff policies and the ongoing AI boom.
items.why: Major US Federal Reserve monetary policy decision to hike interest rates.

items.title: Live: US policymakers expect Fed to raise rates again this year
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates by 25 basis points and policymakers expect one more hike before the end of the year.
items.why: Fed interest rate hike and signal of further tightening is a major central bank policy decision.

items.title: Smart glasses ban looms as Labor sets out new AI rules
items.summary: Smart glasses could be prohibited in Commonwealth workplaces as the government consults on new rules for Australia's growing AI sector.
items.why: Government consulting on new AI sector rules and potential workplace smart glasses prohibition.

items.title: Markets bet 95pc chance of September rate hike after latest RBA comments
items.summary: If you are struggling with current interest rates, the Reserve Bank's leaders delivered the sobering message that they are only just getting back to a "more sensible level".
items.why: Markets sharply pricing in a surprise September rate hike based on new RBA comments.

items.title: 'Clock is ticking' as ASIC warns private credit sector investors could bail
items.summary: ASIC commissioner Simone Constant has fired a shot across the bow of Australian private credit, warning the clock is ticking on poor lending practices.
items.why: ASIC issues a direct regulatory warning over private credit lending practices, signaling potential future enforcement.

items.title: BYD cuts references to 'China' and 'surveillance' from its privacy policy
items.summary: The original policy gave the company almost unlimited powers to collect data on its Australian vehicle owners and broad discretion on how this could be disclosed.
items.why: Corporate privacy policy shift regarding data collection and surveillance for a major automaker.

items.title: Paramount settles with US states, clearing way for Warner Bros merger
items.summary: Opponents say Paramount's multi-billion-dollar merger with Warner Bros will slash Hollywood jobs, reduce the number of films produced, and threaten CNN's independence.
items.why: Settlement with state regulators clears key legal hurdle for major corporate merger.

items.title: Coalition weighing options to use super to boost home ownership
items.summary: A push to allow Australians to use their super to make it easier to buy their first home is being floated by Shadow Housing Minister Andrew Bragg, as the Coalition works through its policy on how to help people enter the housing market.
items.why: New policy proposal allowing superannuation funds for housing purchases.

items.title: Consumers duped by price comparison websites, ASIC warns
items.summary: Australians hunting bargains on comparison websites risk being duped by sites that only offer a selection of preferred providers.
items.why: Financial regulator issues public warning on misleading comparison sites.
